title: The lower bound R(5,5) ≥ 43: a kernel-checked Ramsey graph on 42 vertices
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of Exoo's lower bound R(5,5) ≥ 43 for the diagonal graph Ramsey number: there is a simple graph on 42 vertices with no clique of size 5 and no independent set of size 5. The proof defines a clique scan on natural-number bit masks, proves that a scan with the result `false` excludes every clique of the given size, and lets the Lean kernel evaluate the scan on one explicit graph and on its complement (`decide +kernel`, no `native_decide`). The statement is the one that the Formal Conjectures repository records as `RamseyNumbers.ramsey_number_five_five_lower_bound`. The value of R(5,5) is open; 43 has been the best known lower bound since 1989.
